summary: First E2E run of PIA (FastAPI + React). Backend: 17/18 pytest cases pass (health, stats, samples, analyses list/detail/404, file detail, 3 synthetic jobs -> Suspicious, six 1.17.0 + ms 2.1.3 -> Clean, invalid package job -> failed with message, AI explain -> disabled + persisted, explain preview, watchlist add/409/check/rewind -> release analyzed + alerts, alerts read-all, delete). 1 failure: POST /api/watchlist with nonexistent package -> 500. Frontend: all requested flows work (overview stats/charts/rows nav, analyze form w/ progress -> detail, findings filters, open-file -> diff, file filters, expected-reason, AI disabled msg + payload preview, provenance + 2 rejected entries for left-trim, workspace pages w/ analysis switching, Demo Lab sample/real run+navigate, watchlist add/dup toast/check/rewind/remove, history releases table, alerts + read-all, failed-analysis toast). Found layout overflow bugs and watch-mode 'latest version' logic issue.

critical.issue: Nonexistent package (e.g. pypi 'this-package-does-not-exist-xyz123') returns 500. RCA: WatchService.add -> adapter.list_versions -> http.get_json raises pia.services.http.NotFound which is not an AnalysisInputError, so server.add_watch's except clauses don't catch it. Fix: catch NotFound/HttpError in add_watch (-> 404) or convert to AnalysisInputError inside pypi/npm list_versions.

minor.issue: npm list_versions sorts by publish time, so latest_version for 'ms' = '4.0.0-nightly.202508271359' (prerelease) instead of dist-tags.latest 2.1.3. Rewind/'Demo: replay latest' therefore analyses a nightly with no tag -> Inconclusive (risk 12) instead of the expected Clean 2.1.3. Watch mode also queues prereleases for analysis. Suggest using dist-tags.latest for latest_version and skipping prereleases (configurable).
Always returns 200 {ok:true} even for unknown id (no 404); releases for removed watch remain in DB.
jobs dict grows unbounded and is lost on restart; acceptable for MVP but consider TTL eviction.

ui_bugs.issue: After clicking 'Preview data sent', the <pre> with long snippet lines stretches its card to ~2650px; document scrollWidth becomes 3055px at 1920 viewport (whole page scrolls horizontally, card extends off-screen). Add min-w-0 to the grid column / card and overflow-x-auto + max-w-full on the pre (or whitespace-pre-wrap break-all).

For files with long lines (colorfmt-synth setup.py base64 line), the table is 2716px wide inside a 1014px container; the 'Repository source' column starts at x=2834 so users only see the package column unless they scroll horizontally - side-by-side comparison is effectively hidden. Use table-fixed with 50/50 columns and per-cell overflow/ellipsis or wrap.
After 'Mark all read' on Alerts page, sidebar nav-alert-count keeps showing the old count until the 15s /stats refresh. readAll/read should also mutate('/stats').

issues: 'File comparison (10)' tab count differs from 'All 11' filter count (filter includes repo_only files) - inconsistent numbers.
X-axis labels (pkg@version) are rotated and overlap/cramped with 15+ analyses; consider truncating or hiding ticks.

action_items: Catch http NotFound/HttpError in POST /api/watchlist (return 404 instead of 500)
npm watch: use dist-tags.latest for latest_version and skip prereleases so rewind replays a real stable release
Fix horizontal page overflow from AI payload preview <pre>
Make DiffViewer repository column visible for long lines (fixed 50/50 layout)
Refresh /stats SWR after alerts read/read-all so nav badge updates instantly
critical_code_review_comments: useAnalysisJob: api.get inside setInterval has no try/catch - a transient network error causes unhandled promise rejection and the interval keeps polling silently; add error handling/timeout.
server.py remove_watch returns ok for unknown ids; consider 404.
No endpoint to delete analyses, so test/demo runs accumulate permanently in the DB.
seed_data_creation: Analyses created via tests (synthetic x3+, six, ms 2.1.3, ms 4.0.0-nightly via watch) - no delete API exists so they remain. Watch item npm:ms was added and removed (twice); its release records and alerts remain (no delete API).

Watch IDs contain ':' - URL-encode. Fixed analysis ids: colorfmt 16e70520eee1, left-trim 651def66d166. Retest AI preview overflow (document.documentElement.scrollWidth should equal viewport) and diff viewer repo column visibility.
